lines.zh: 我在珊瑚枝间钻来钻去。
lines.en: I weave in and out of the coral branches.

lines.zh: 我贴着海葵边游，最安全。
lines.en: I swim by the anemone's edge; safest there.

lines.zh: 橙白条纹一晃，我过去了。
lines.en: Orange and white flash — that was me.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝窄，我侧身挤进去。
lines.en: The coral gap is narrow; I squeeze sideways.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我偏要顶回去。
lines.en: The current pushes; I push right back.
I make a small loop around the rock.

lines.zh: 我游得急，尾巴拍出水花。
lines.en: I swim fast; my tail kicks up spray.

lines.zh: 前面有条大鱼，我躲进枝里。
lines.en: A big fish ahead — I duck into the coral.
I slip down the reef slope.

lines.zh: 一群同伴在前头，我跟上。
lines.en: My school is ahead; I catch up.
I skim the sand, looking for a gap.
I take a sharp turn back into the coral.
The water is clear; I can see far.

lines.zh: 我摆两下尾，就到了礁顶。
lines.en: Two tail strokes and I reach the reef top.

lines.zh: 我在海葵触手里蹭了一下。
lines.en: I brush through the anemone's tentacles.

lines.zh: 前面的珊瑚枝太密，我钻。
lines.en: The coral branch is dense, so I slip through.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石背面走，避开大鱼。
lines.en: I hug the back of the reef to avoid big fish.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，我换到另一丛珊瑚。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I change coral.

lines.zh: 我停在海葵触手边不动。
lines.en: I hover still beside the anemone's tentacles.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在光里很扎眼。
lines.en: My stripes stand out in the light.

lines.zh: 有条小鱼从珊瑚里探头。
lines.en: A little fish peeks from the coral.

lines.zh: 我吐了个小泡，看它散开。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it break.
Algae on the rock sways gently.
I count the schools swimming past.
The sea is warm; I cannot be bothered.
I doze in the coral's shadow.
Has that big fish gone?
I fan my fins and hover in place.
The reef is noisy with clicks.
I wiggle to shake off the fine sand.
I know every crack in this reef.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，反正我不赶时间。
lines.en: Slow down — I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你隔着水面看我，我歪头。
lines.en: You watch me through the surface; I tilt.

lines.zh: 你的手贴在玻璃外？没有玻璃。
lines.en: Your hand pressed to glass? There is none.

lines.zh: 我游到珊瑚边，离你最近。
lines.en: I swim to the coral closest to you.
There is a little fish basket at your waist.
I am not afraid; you move slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子让珊瑚暗了一块。
lines.en: Your shadow darkens a patch of coral.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的倒影游一圈。
lines.en: I swim one lap around your reflection.
Are you counting my stripes?
I duck away, then peek out again.
Do not tap the surface; I hear well.
Half my tail fin was bitten off.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的条纹都乱了。
lines.en: That hit left my stripes in disarray.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚缝，喘个不停。
lines.en: I dive into the coral gap, gasping.
Blood drifts in the water; I must go.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里，我的鳞被刮了。
lines.en: A reef crack scraped my scales.
Who bit me? I know that smell now.

lines.zh: 我贴着海葵，动都不敢动。
lines.en: I press to the anemone, afraid to move.
One more bite and I am gone.
Three laps before I shook it off.
A small wound, but I am truly scared.

lines.zh: 你撒的碎食落下来，我冲了。
lines.en: Your crumbs sink; I charge.
That little red thing looks like shrimp.

lines.zh: 我绕到海葵边，等你再撒。
lines.en: I wait by the anemone for more.

lines.zh: 味儿一飘过来，我就忍不住。
lines.en: The scent drifts over, and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 同伴都聚过去了，我也去。
lines.en: My school gathers there; I join.
I stare at that wobble on the surface.
Drop one more — just one.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚缝里探出来抢。
lines.en: I dart from the coral gap to grab it.
If I cannot get it, I circle nearby.
The thing in your palm is moving.

lines.zh: 你蹚水进来，珊瑚都晃了。
lines.en: You wade in and the coral shakes.

lines.zh: 我撞在礁壁上，鳞有点疼。
lines.en: I hit the reef wall; my scales sting.

lines.zh: 大鱼蹭过去，把我推歪了。
lines.en: A big fish brushes past and knocks me askew.

lines.zh: 我和同伴撞在一起，散开了。
lines.en: My schoolmate and I collide and scatter.

lines.zh: 别踩这块礁，我住在下面。
lines.en: Do not step on this rock; I live under it.

lines.zh: 水波一涌，我打了两个转。
lines.en: A surge spins me twice around.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿游开，没碰着。
lines.en: I slip past your leg without touching.

lines.zh: 这一挤，我的条纹都歪了。
lines.en: That squeeze bent my stripes crooked.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝断了一截，掉在我旁边。
lines.en: A coral branch snapped off beside me.
I am small, but hits still hurt.

lines.zh: 另一条小丑鱼靠近海葵。
lines.en: Another clownfish nears the anemone.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，绕着礁转。
lines.en: We circle the reef, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 它的鳍碰了一下我的尾。
lines.en: Its fin brushed my tail.

lines.zh: 两条橙白影子并在一起。
lines.en: Two orange-white shadows merge.

lines.zh: 我给它让出最暖的那块水。
lines.en: I give it the warmest patch of water.

lines.zh: 我们在海葵上方慢慢打转。
lines.en: We turn slowly above the anemone.
It hides, I chase — three laps.

lines.zh: 这一带很快会有小鱼苗。
lines.en: There will be tiny fry around here soon.
Do not come close; we are pairing.
My tail fin brushes lightly against its tail.

lines.zh: 掉下来的碎食，我一口叼住。
lines.en: A crumb falls; I snatch it at once.

lines.zh: 那东西太大，我推了两下。
lines.en: It is too big; I shove it twice.
I carry it back into the coral gap.
It is stuck between branches, out of reach.

lines.zh: 我一松嘴，它又沉下去了。
lines.en: I let go, and it sinks again.
A schoolmate grabs at it; I turn and flee.
This thing shines too much to be food.
I butt it once; it does not budge.

lines.zh: 碎虾肉卡在珊瑚枝上，我去够。
lines.en: Bits of shrimp caught in the coral; I reach for them.
If it drops, fine — I do not want it.
A small shrimp moves by the coral.
I fix on that little white shadow.
It is very close to my anemone.
I turn, tail fin tucked.
It is small — one bite exactly.
I keep my target pinned in the gap.
It tries to hide; I block the front.
The prey is half my size.
Hold still; let me judge the distance.
That is the one; I am ready to dash.
I follow it through the coral.
It goes left; I turn early.
I hug the reef, keeping low.
The gap shrinks; I hold still.
When it pauses, I creep closer.
The water is clear; sneaking is hard.

lines.zh: 我在海葵触手间穿过去。
lines.en: I slip through the anemone's tentacles.
It spotted me and started to flee.

lines.zh: 我追得急，撞了一下珊瑚。
lines.en: I chase hard and clip the coral.
Half a foot closer will do.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，它挣了两下。
lines.en: I bite; it struggles twice.
One bump and it flips belly-up.
My mouth is small; the bite is slow.
Its shell is hard; I cannot bite through.
Three bites before I stop.
In the spray I hold on tight.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我只敢咬尾巴。
lines.en: It is bigger; I only dare bite its tail.
That one, I overdid it.

lines.zh: 它跑了，我嘴里留了片鳞。
lines.en: It escaped, leaving a scale in my mouth.
After eating I must hide; sharks come.
I open my eyes among the coral branches.
This reef is warm and brightly colored.

lines.zh: 我和另一条一起游出来。
lines.en: Another clownfish and I swim out together.

lines.zh: 我第一条看见的就是海葵。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the anemone.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里多了两条橙影。
lines.en: Two orange shadows joined the coral gap.
The water is clear; I am not used to it.
First I circle the rock to learn the way.
There are so many big fish here.
My stripes are not fully grown yet.
Hide in the anemone, and no one finds me.

lines.zh: 海水烫起来，我的鳍缩了。
lines.en: The sea boils; my fins curl.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在礁上。
lines.en: Flung from the water, I land on the reef.
Out of water, my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 冲击把珊瑚炸碎，我懵了。
lines.en: The blast shatters coral; I am stunned.
The anemone is not safe anymore.
This force pins me in place.

lines.zh: 礁上没吃的，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: No food on the reef; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea; I jolt all over.

lines.zh: 这里没有珊瑚，我找不到家。
lines.en: No coral here; I cannot find home.
